title: Caregiver setup
intro: Set up the activity space for the person you are with. You can change any of this later.
noInference: Names, relationships, captions and prompts come from you and are shown as you wrote them. Optional on-device object suggestions are clearly marked and stay hidden until you review them. Nothing is uploaded for object suggestions.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Profile display name
profile.nameHint: How this profile is shown on the first screen.
profile.newProfile: No profile is saved in this browser yet. A new one is created when you save.
profile.homePhotos: Photographs added in Personalise Home (portraits, the wall photograph and the event photograph) are also offered in sessions, with the names, relationships and caption you typed there.

language.title: Language
language.preferredHint: Used for the activity space's text and spoken prompts. It is only ever what you choose here.

place.title: Place
place.intro: Choose a content pack and one of its places. You can still choose a different place at the start of a session.
place.regionalNote: These packs include a few region-specific objects. They are never chosen automatically.
place.savedUnavailable: The place saved earlier is not available now. Choose another place, or keep no preference.

mode.title: How a session starts
mode.openHint: Look around freely and choose what to look at.
mode.guidedHint: Go through the sequence you arrange below, in order.
mode.assist: Show the caregiver panel by default
mode.assistHint: The panel has the list of prompts and a place for your notes.

topics.title: Conversation topics
topics.intro: Choose topics to include more often, and topics to leave out. Objects and prompts tagged with a topic to leave out are not shown.

objects.title: Objects in this place
objects.intro: Open an object to hide it, change the name or description shown, or add your own prompt.
objects.choosePlace: Choose a place above to see its objects.
objects.label: Name shown
objects.descriptionHintNone: Leave empty to show no description.
objects.avoidedByTopic: This object is left out while these topics are left out: {topics}.

photos.title: Photographs
photos.intro: Add photographs of people, places and occasions. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {maxMb} MB each, and up to {max} photographs. The original file is kept.
photos.peopleHint: Only names and relationships you type are shown. Nobody is recognised from a picture.
photos.caption: Caption
photos.captionHint: Your own words. Leave empty for no caption.
photos.surfaceHint: Frames and albums in the chosen place.
photos.surfaceNone: Choose a place above to pick a frame.
photos.depthHint: Make this photograph explorable, so it can be looked into a little from its close-up. The depth is worked out on this device from the picture's shapes alone. The photograph is not sent anywhere, and nothing is recognised or added.
photos.depthWorking: Working out depth. The first time can take a little while…
photos.depthReady: Ready. This photograph can now be stepped into from its close-up.
photos.depthHas: This photograph can be stepped into from its close-up.
photos.objectsHint: Suggest objects in this photograph using an on-device model. Suggestions are not facts: choose which ones to show and correct their names. Nothing is uploaded.
photos.objectsWorking: Looking for possible objects on this device…
photos.objectsReady: Found {count} suggestions. Review each one below; none are shown until you choose them.
photos.objectsNone: No suggestions found. You can still explore the photograph and its depth.
photos.objectsNotInstalled: Object suggestions are not installed in this build. Run npm run setup:room-models and rebuild.
photos.objectsUnsupported: This browser cannot run on-device object suggestions.
photos.objectsFailed: Could not analyse this photograph. You can continue without object suggestions.
photos.objectDescriptionHint: Only what you write is shown when this object is selected.
photos.depthNotInstalled: The depth model is not installed here. Run “npm run setup:depth” and reload.
photos.depthUnsupported: This browser cannot work out depth.
photos.depthFailed: Depth could not be worked out for this photograph.

sounds.title: Sounds and voice messages
sounds.intro: Add familiar sounds or voice messages. MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG or WebM, up to {maxMb} MB and {maxMin} minutes each, and up to {max} sounds.
sounds.name: Title

prompt.title: Your prompt (optional)
prompt.hint: An open question in your own words, for example: Would you like to tell us about this?
prompt.langHint: Used to choose a voice if the prompt is spoken aloud.
prompt.hasRecording: A recording is attached. It plays instead of a synthetic voice.

record.hint: The microphone is used only while you record, and only after you press this button.
record.started: Recording. Press Stop recording when you are done.
record.oneAtATime: Another recording is in progress. Stop it first.

sequence.title: Guided sequence
sequence.intro: Arrange photographs, objects and sounds in the order you would like to go through them.
sequence.nothingToAdd: Everything available is already in the sequence. Add photographs or sounds, or choose a place, to have more to add.

brokenMedia.one: {count} item could not be shown or played. It is kept until you replace or remove it.
brokenMedia.other: {count} items could not be shown or played. They are kept until you replace or remove them.

validation.homeProfile: Personalise Home needs attention before this profile can be saved:
validation.conflict: A different profile was saved in this browser while this editor was open. Nothing was changed. Close this editor and open it once more.

actions.discardTitle: Discard the changes you made here?
